leeds_boutique_keeper.text: Now then. Leeds got rich on wool and we still know good cloth when we see it. Mind your head on the brass.

then.text: That {worn_coat} is a good bit of kit. Sensible. Yorkshire approves.
A {worn_hat}. Fair play. You'll have people asking you where the nearest pie is.
That {worn_top} is decent. Nowt wrong with it.
That {worn_neck} sits well on you. A good thing at your throat saves a lot of grumbling.
And those {worn_shoes}: you can tell a lot from a person's feet. Good things.

else.text: Plain as a Yorkshire pudding with no gravy. Let's fix that.

leeds_boutique_keeper.text: Come back when you want something else. We don't close, we just get sleepier.
